{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Data types:\n", df.dtypes)
print("\nMissing values:\n", df.isnull().sum())
print("\nUnique values in customer_age:\n", df['customer_age'].unique())
print("\nFirst few values of customer_age:\n", df['customer_age'].head())

# Check for sentinel values
sentinel_count = (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"\nNumber of -1 values in customer_age: {sentinel_count}")"}
